places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Wild town of saloons and whores; July writes home, gets drunk waiting for Elmira's friend Jennie, and learns Dee Boot is alive.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: July finds its cow towns as rough as Missourians claimed.

places.name: Missouri
places.note: July once testified at a trial there; Jennie heard Ellie moved there and wed an Arkansas sheriff.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July's home town, to which he writes Peach reporting the deaths and that he may not return as sheriff.

places.name: Abilene
places.note: Ellie once lived there, leaving Dodge suddenly with mule skinners; July guesses she might be there now.

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: July recalls getting the letter about Ellie at its post office.

places.name: St. Joseph
places.note: Where July found Ellie after she left Abilene.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Dee Boot is said to be there; a gambler saw him a couple of months back, and Jennie thinks Ellie is chasing him.

places.name: Deadwood
places.note: The postal clerk guesses his nephew Dee Boot may be there or in Ogallala.
places.location_hint: Dakota Territory, in the Black Hills

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Rumor reached Dodge that Ellie married a sheriff from there.

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Where little Joe was killed, July tells Jennie.

groups.label: July Johnson
groups.hint: riding out of Dodge City alone at night on a new horse, Pete, to keep searching for Elmira
